'''Valhoun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the leader of an elite unit called [[Valhoun's Vultures]]. During the [[Galactic War]], he commanded his unit to many victories against the Sith Empire across the galaxy. He was killed by an Imperial-affiliated individual while on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].
